summary: We developed a website made for young space Enthusiasts ,Who want to flourish and enlarge their Knowledge about Nasa and space. This website encourages to explore the discarded artifacts left on Mars and The Moon, it is important as it helps young people get into their passion about space, and how items are we had made in the earth are now out in mars/moon, It also plays a key role into finding more about how much progress we as human beings made.
details: It works as a website which is accessible to everyone ,It shows why and which items were discarded on the moon and mars. The benefits are that it provides information and pictures of what artifacts were lost on the moon and mars ,or why they were left there, the impact of this project is to encourage young people to get to know more about space and how it works, this was created a collective group effort as information was confirmed and checked my ChatGPT and Gemini and the website was helped made by Wix ,as our coding skills are quite mediocre, the project creativity focus by keeping a consist and arranged colour scheme and arrangements and the handwritten notes on the PowerPoint and and decoration played a huge part in the creative part ,the team considered the fact of how appealing and effect it is to keep and help young people get fully immersed and attentive while simultaneously making it fun and colourful
